yeori.name: 서여리
yeori.descriptor: Consistent character face: Oval face with warm fair skin, almond-shaped hazel-brown eyes, full dark eyebrows, a straight medium nose, full naturally pink lips with a gentle smile, and long wavy dark brown hair NOT short parted loosely; clear even skin with a single small beauty mark near the right cheekbone; avoid acne blemishes redness rough skin.

jia.name: 한지아
jia.descriptor: Consistent character face: oval face shape, large dark brown almond eyes with dramatic curled lashes and subtle winged black eyeliner, softly arched dark brows, a straight refined nose, full lips with a defined cupid's bow in deep mauve-brown, fair warm skin tone with a small mole near the nose, short wavy black bob with wispy curtain bangs.
jia.notes: 서여리 절친 · 즉흥/리액션형 · 다크 마룬 립 시그니처 · 첫 등장 LF_T01
jia.aliasesNote: HJ/HJ_VD 추가 — LF_T01 대본이 CH: YR_TX + HJ 로 표기 (YEORI 의 YR_* 와 대칭)

jiyu.name: 지유
jiyu.descriptor: Consistent character face: youthful early-20s Korean woman, soft rounded face with full rosy cheeks and a small chin, porcelain-fair skin with a natural pink flush, dark brown eyes that curve gently when she smiles, soft straight full bangs covering the forehead, very long straight glossy jet-black hair falling well past the chest (NOT wavy, NOT bob, NOT shoulder-length), glossy coral-red lip tint, bright friendly smile.
jiyu.descriptorSource: claude-vision (2차 테스트 캐릭터 시트, 성준님 확인)
jiyu.notes: 서여리 또래 절친 2 · 먼저 웃음을 터뜨리는 발랄한 분위기 메이커 · 코랄 레드 틴트 시그니처 · 레퍼런스 v2(2차 테스트): 얼굴=CU 2번, 전신=FS 8번(빈티지 쇼츠) · 풀뱅+아주 긴 생머리 · 앳된 얼굴이라 장면마다 성인(20대 초반) 신호(메이크업·액세서리·카페/자취방 등) 함께 · 이전 레퍼런스 downloads/flow/character/_old/ · 첫 등장 예정 = 후보 #4 흑역사 챌린지
